capabilities: Visualize an ink story's knots, stitches, choices, diverts, tunnels and threads as a node map
Edit the story on the map by creating knots, dragging links, renaming and deleting
Highlight where a variable is written and read across the story
Warn about cycles without choices that would hang the player
Save node positions in a sidecar file next to the story
disambiguation: Not a graph view of vault notes; it maps the structure of .ink interactive-fiction story files only.
extras: README documents known limits: large stories rebuild slowly on the main thread, unclosed braces can hide parts of the graph while typing, and delete shortcuts lack a touch equivalent on phones.
problem: Ink stories are plain text, so writers have no visual way to see story structure, variable flow, or loops that would hang the story.

relations.evidence: Works alongside Ink Player and Ink Language.
Works alongside Ink Player and Ink Language.

summary: Story graph for ink files that draws knots, choices, diverts and variables as a map and edits the story by dragging links.
